facts.statement: The Board has 11 directors: the 11 nominees for one-year terms expiring at the 2023 annual meeting (an 11-director slate within a 10 to 12 director objective) were all elected to the Board at the 2021 annual meeting.
11 directors will constitute the Board immediately following the 2022 annual meeting.

Sitting directors nominated for re-election: Quincy L. Allen, Martha Helena Bejar, Peter C. Brown, Kevin P. Chilton, Steven T. “Terry” Clontz, T. Michael Glenn, W. Bruce Hanks, Hal Stanley Jones, Michael Roberts, Laurie Siegel and Jeffrey K. Storey.
Quincy L. Allen is a director (Director since 2021).
Martha Helena Bejar is a director (Director since 2016).
Peter C. Brown is a director (Director since 2009).
Kevin P. Chilton is a director (Director since 2017).
Steven T. “Terry” Clontz is a director (Director since 2017).
T. Michael Glenn is a director (Director since 2017).
W. Bruce Hanks is a director (Director since 1992).
Hal Stanley Jones is a director (Director since 2020).
Michael Roberts is a director (Director since 2011).
Laurie Siegel is a director (Director since 2009).
Jeffrey K. Storey, President and CEO, is a director (Director since 2017).
10 of the 11 directors/nominees (91%) are independent; all directors other than the CEO are independent.
Independent directors: Allen, Bejar, Brown, Chilton, Clontz, Glenn, Hanks, Jones, Roberts and Siegel; President and CEO Jeffrey K. Storey is the only non-independent director.
In early 2022 the Board reviewed all relationships between the Company and each director and affirmatively determined that all director nominees are independent other than CEO Storey.
All non-CEO directors have been independent since the 2020 annual meeting.
T. Michael Glenn is the independent, non-executive Chairman of the Board.
Effective May 20, 2020, Glenn became the independent, non-executive Chairman, with Hanks continuing as Vice Chairman; the filing also lists an independent Chairman named at the 2020 annual meeting.
W. Bruce Hanks is Vice Chairman of the Board.
The Chairman and CEO positions are separate; a non-executive chairman has been elected since 2009.
The Board has four standing committees: Audit; Human Resources and Compensation (HRCC); Nominating and Corporate Governance (NCG); Risk and Security.
Audit Committee: W. Bruce Hanks (Chair), Quincy L. Allen, Peter C. Brown, Kevin P. Chilton and Hal Stanley Jones.
Each Audit Committee member (Hanks, Allen, Brown, Chilton, Jones) is an audit committee financial expert.
Human Resources and Compensation Committee: Laurie Siegel (Chair), T. Michael Glenn (the Board Chairman), Steven T. “Terry” Clontz, Michael Roberts and Martha H. Bejar.
During the last fiscal year the HRCC included Siegel, Bejar, Clontz, Glenn and Roberts; no HRCC member served as a Company officer or employee prior to or while serving on the HRCC.
Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee: Martha Helena Bejar (Chair), Michael Roberts, Steven T. “Terry” Clontz and Laurie Siegel.
Risk and Security Committee: Kevin P. Chilton (Chair), Quincy L. Allen, Peter C. Brown, Jeffrey K. Storey (non-independent CEO) and Hal Stanley Jones.
All members of the Audit, HRCC and NCG committees are independent; the HRCC consists entirely of independent directors.
Quincy L. Allen was appointed to (joined) the Board effective February 25, 2021, after a search by a firm the NCG Committee retained in 2020.
Hal Stanley Jones was added to (joined) the Board effective January 1, 2020.
The term of former director Virginia Boulet ended at the 2021 annual shareholders meeting.
The NCG Committee Chair was rotated at the 2020 annual meeting.

unresolved.reason: The 2020 NCG Committee Chair rotation does not name the outgoing or incoming chair; when current chair Bejar took the role is not stated.
Retirements of several directors announced in connection with adding Mr. Jones are not tied to named directors or dates in this filing.
